resources.string:
The project "Pojav Glow·Worm" is a modified version by Vera-Firefly, based on the PojavLauncher Which is a Minecraft launcher for Android devices to run Minecraft: Java Edition. Pojav Glow·Worm has made significant changes to the renderer selection options and added more experimental features. You can find more renderer configuration options in the experimental renderer settings.

Thanks to MCHeads for providing Minecraft avatars.

Pojav Glow·Worm is a modern Minecraft: Java Edition launcher for Android, built on PojavLauncher. Featuring a beautiful violet glassmorphism UI, advanced renderer support (Mesa/VirGL/Freedreno/Panfrost), custom controls, mod management, and experimental features for the best mobile Minecraft experience.

Boardwalk JVM • LWJGL3 • Mesa 3D • GL4ES • VirGL • OpenJDK • Pro-Grade • Terminal View • AndroidX • Material Components • Gson • OkHttp • CommonMark • XZ for Java • And many more open source libraries.
